name: saanseoi/overturist
what_it_holds: Small MIT-licensed CLI (9 stars, updated 6 Sep 2026, active) for obtaining data from Overture Maps, including the Places theme.
why_useful: Lightweight, actively-updated CLI alternative for pulling Overture Places by bbox/category for a lodging-supply count.
duplicate_of_holding: functionally overlaps other Overture downloaders above
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Lightweight, actively-updated CLI alternative for pulling Overture Places by bbox/category for a lodging-supply count.

name: project-terraforma/Mayhem_Attribute_Conflation
what_it_holds: Apache-2.0 pipeline (10 stars) that resolves attribute conflicts across multiple source feeds inside Overture Maps POI data using ML + rule-based heuristics to produce unified 'golden record' POIs.
why_useful: Relevant to data-quality of any hotel/lodging POI count built from Overture (Overture places are conflated from multiple sources incl. Meta, Microsoft, community feeds, TomTom -- duplicate/attribute conflicts affect a supply count); useful as a QC method reference, not a dataset itself.
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Relevant to data-quality of any hotel/lodging POI count built from Overture (Overture places are conflated from multiple sources incl. Meta, Microsoft, community feeds, TomTom -- duplicate/attribute conflicts affect a supply count); useful as a QC method reference, not a dataset itself.

name: julien-noblet/download-geofabrik
what_it_holds: MPL-2.0 tool (35 stars, updated 7 Sep 2026, actively maintained) for downloading OSM .osm.pbf files from Geofabrik by region/country.
why_useful: Simple, actively-maintained downloader for Geofabrik extracts as the raw input to a tourism=hotel/guest_house tag count; minimal-dependency alternative to the R/Python packages above.
time_coverage: current OSM snapshot at run time
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Simple, actively-maintained downloader for Geofabrik extracts as the raw input to a tourism=hotel/guest_house tag count; minimal-dependency alternative to the R/Python packages above.

name: mansueto-institute/prclz
what_it_holds: GPL-3.0 repo (14 stars) of topological/graph-theoretic tools to study urban infrastructure at global scale, built on OSM data via Geofabrik-style extracts (parcels, building footprints, block complexity), from a University of Chicago urban-economics lab.
why_useful: Academic-grade toolkit for measuring urban built-form density from OSM globally -- a possible proxy input for identifying informal/dense STR-supply-prone neighborhoods, though it is not lodging-specific.
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Academic-grade toolkit for measuring urban built-form density from OSM globally -- a possible proxy input for identifying informal/dense STR-supply-prone neighborhoods, though it is not lodging-specific.

name: edisedis777/Coffee-Shops-Analysis
what_it_holds: Notebook analyzing the Foursquare Open Source Places dataset for US coffee shop distribution (Portland focus). No lodging content, but confirms the Foursquare OS Places dataset is usable/queryable at the repo level (Foursquare Places, AGPL-3.0 repo, 0 stars).
why_useful: Confirms usability of the Foursquare OS Places dataset via a working example pipeline, but not itself lodging-relevant -- low value as a standalone catalogue entry, kept as evidence the FSQ dataset is broadly workable.
time_coverage: current FSQ release at run time
themes: POI and place data: Overture Maps places, OSM extracts (tourism=*), Foursquare open places, Geofabrik tooling; counting STR/hotel supply from maps
why_all: Confirms usability of the Foursquare OS Places dataset via a working example pipeline, but not itself lodging-relevant -- low value as a standalone catalogue entry, kept as evidence the FSQ dataset is broadly workable.
